note: B23 upstairs, L'auto-école: the driving-school loft under the garage roof (stone walls, dark beams and rafters, skylights, plank floor), camera at the south end facing north. A big play-mat road with a crossroads and a small roundabout covers the floor. Landmark: the tall glazed French doors at the back, open onto the terrace (exit to R_road_02_z1). Feminine LEFT: circus bear in a red waistcoat riding a unicycle round the little roundabout (circulation); white mother duck leading three ducklings over the zebra crossing (priorité); one giant red high-heeled shoe standing on the road mat (chaussée). Masculine RIGHT: four little toy cars meeting at the crossroads (carrefour); big snail riding past a line of toy cars (trafic); giraffe crossing guard in a hi-vis vest holding up a blank red octagon sign (stop); panda shaking its head beside a blank round sign on a post (panneau); boy in a cardboard-box car turning right round to go back (demi-tour); orange traffic cone closing the road so cars must go round it (détour); giant brown lace-up boot standing in the road with a queue of toy cars jammed behind it (embouteillage, matches the user hook qa_020 'boot'). Exits: the stair hole with banister at near left -> down to the workshop R_road_03; the French doors -> R_road_02_z1. Zoom: the driving simulator on the right -> R_road_02_z2. Colour: warm stone/wood toned down so it passes colour_check (walls read a little greyer than downstairs). 2026-10-22 09:05: the milk bottle was replaced by the giant boot (local 1:1 crop edit, feathered composite) so the painting matches the user's qa_020 hook; the boot heel sits about 30 px from the right edge (box clipped to the 6% margin).
